# Nothing new again, so I won't ask for another run

The Last run commit is already in: `a11a18b` on `s1-spec`, and the working tree is clean.

I read the evidence on disk. The leak scan is clean and each run's code matches the approved version. Compared with the last run, the only thing that changed in any of the three files is the run time:
- **PB-01 and PB-02** still recorded `http://127.0.0.1:65147/v1.0/data`, for the third time since you unset the variables. Your message doesn't say whether you ran them with the `env -u …` commands. Every result is identical to before.
- **PB-03** recorded `usage` for the fourth time. That means the script received no step name it recognised, even though you ran `compare`. Nothing else in the evidence explains why.

The same outcome four times means more reruns won't help, and I won't patch or re-stamp working scripts to chase this. I also haven't updated the Last run times this round, since the results are unchanged.

**What I recommend:** pause all three probes. They stay Ready, and AD-03, AD-04 and AD-05 stay Proposed with their lines under Risks. build-planning waits, while pipeline-design and test-planning go on.

You can resume any time. When a run records `https://api.sharadar.com/v1.0/data` as its address, or PB-03 records a C4 result, say "ran it" and I'll record it.

**The alternative is to waive.** For any of the three, tell me in your own words why the decision can go ahead without the probe. I'll set it to `Waived · 2026-10-18 — <your words>`, and the decision's line under Risks stays. On what we have, waiving PB-01 would mean accepting AD-03 without seeing your real S&P 500 membership data. That was the check that mattered most.

Pause all three, or waive any of them?
